stage0063_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Night's stars circle, soon to reach the heavens」

stage0063_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「That moment will be the end of our lives...」

stage0063_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Humans!
　Eternity will never come for you!」

stage0063_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Only the chosen shall live forever!」

stage0063_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$シモン$$
「What's wrong, everyone?
　Did you all eat too much of $$ニア$$'s cooking?」

stage0063_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Guess not, huh?
　You all seemed strangely reluctant to eat」

stage0063_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Hey, you!
　Why are you laughing so cheerfully?!」

stage0063_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アスカ$$
「In the first place, it's your wife's...」

stage0063_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$アスカ$$!
　Look, it's the African continent!
　Can you see the herd of elephants!?」

stage0063_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Wh-what is it, all of a sudden...」

stage0063_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$n
（Stop it, $$アスカ$$...
　We're the ones intruding on the newlyweds' home）

stage0063_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Even if that dish tasted lethal,
　we shouldn't complain...）

stage0063_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シモン$$
「We're almost at the next stop.
　Pull yourselves together」

stage0063_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$シモン$$
「I finally got to eat $$ニア$$'s cooking again」

stage0063_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If you've got energy to spare, spar with me.
　Next up's probably the showdown with the
　Mechanical Beast Army, so let's warm up right」

stage0063_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シモン$$
「Just what I wanted.
　Let's head to the hangar」

stage0063_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That guy...
　However you look at it, he ate at least
　twenty times what we did...」

stage0063_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Far from getting sick, he's in perfect shape...」

stage0063_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$n
「Now I get what $$キタン$$ meant
　by 'a good match'」

stage0063_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Even my guts couldn't finish that,
　but still...」

stage0063_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Why is Ayanami the only one... unaffected...」

stage0063_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$甲児$$
「That was rough on you guys」

stage0063_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$n
「$$甲児$$...
　You knew, so why didn't you stop it?」

stage0063_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$甲児$$
「Don't be so mad.
　Everything in life's a learning experience, right?」

stage0063_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$n
「You think that kind of logic will fly?」

stage0063_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$甲児$$
「I said stop with the $$ブーストアップ$$...!
　It was my fault!」

stage0063_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here, soup to clear your palate.
　Even a weak stomach should handle this」

stage0063_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アスカ$$
「It's infuriating...
　$$甲児$$'s cooking, of all things, is amazing...」

stage0063_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$甲児$$
「There's plenty of seconds, too.
　Help yourselves from that pot over there」

stage0063_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm gonna go make a call.
　...$$タケル$$, I'll leave the rest to you」

stage0063_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That person is... $$甲児$$'s mother, right?」

stage0063_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$タケル$$
「And $$くろがね屋$$'s proprietress was once part
　of the Bardos Island Mycenaean survey team」

stage0063_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Mycenae's behind the Mechanical Beasts, right?」

stage0063_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$n
「That's right.
　Dr. Hell used giant robots dug from Mycenaean
　ruins, and turned them into Mechanical Beasts」

stage0063_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$タケル$$
「And now that Dr. Hell has fallen,
　$$あしゅら男爵$$ has inherited that legacy」

stage0063_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「The Mycenae ruins in the Mediterranean we're
　headed to are believed to be the Beast Army's base」

stage0063_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「The Beast Army movements $$ロージェノム$$ warned of...」

stage0063_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$甲児$$'s probably contacting the proprietress,
　who's deeply tied to $$あしゅら$$, to get that info」

stage0063_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But, $$甲児$$...
　he looked like he had something heavy on his mind...」

stage0063_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Asking about the proprietress's past
　leads back to $$甲児$$'s father's death」

stage0063_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$甲児$$'s father, Kenzo Kabuto, was on that team too...」

stage0063_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「But he was parasitized by Kedora, a Mycenaean
　mechanical life-form, and became its puppet...」

stage0063_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「In the end, the proprietress struck him down herself」

stage0063_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「That's right.
　His father was killed by his mother's own hand」

stage0063_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Such a past between $$甲児$$ and the proprietress...」

stage0063_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$つばさ$$
「...I see.
　So you'll finally settle things with $$あしゅら$$ and the others」

stage0063_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$つばさ$$
「I've got nothing to say.
　Just go give it your all」

stage0063_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$甲児$$
「...Mom, do you know what
　$$あしゅら$$'s fighting for?」

stage0063_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$甲児$$
「I can't believe that $$あしゅら$$, now that he's
　regained his memories as a Mycenaean, is avenging
　Dr. Hell, who only used him」

stage0063_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$甲児$$
「But I don't think he's after world domination
　either, not the way he is now」

stage0063_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even if he's fighting to settle things with me,
　his actions are just too baffling」

stage0063_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even Grandpa, $$マジンガーＺ$$'s computer, is
　still asleep, so I've got no leads at all.
　Any idea, Mom?」

stage0063_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$つばさ$$
「...Sorry.
　There's nothing I can tell you」

stage0063_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$つばさ$$
「But if $$あしゅら$$'s got his Mycenaean memories
　back, that works in our favor too.
　It's our chance to seize the Mycenaean legacy」

stage0063_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Chogokin Z and Photon Energy, which gave birth
　to $$マジンガーＺ$$, the overwhelmingly powerful Beasts...」

stage0063_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$甲児$$
「And Kedora, the mechanical life-form
　that cost Dad his life...」

stage0063_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sorry, Mom...
　I'm not blaming you」

stage0063_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$つばさ$$
「It's fine...
　For me, it's all ancient history now」

stage0063_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$つばさ$$
「But if we get our hands on the Mycenaean legacy,
　we might just overturn how things stand now」

stage0063_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$甲児$$
「...Are you talking about $$エタニティ・フラット$$?」

stage0063_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Don't underestimate me.
　Even $$くろがね屋$$ hears that much」

stage0063_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$つばさ$$
「So, $$甲児$$... I'm counting on you.
　For $$シロー$$'s sake too, protect this world's future」

stage0063_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's rare...
　for you to say something like that, Mom」

stage0063_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$つばさ$$
「I'm no spring chicken myself.
　I'll leave the rest to you youngsters」

stage0063_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Got it, Mom.
　I'll show you」

stage0063_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll settle things with $$あしゅら$$, fight $$バアル$$,
　and break the Prison of Time too, I swear」

stage0063_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Do your best.
　Once it's settled, come by $$くろがね屋$$」

stage0063_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$つばさ$$
「Take a hot bath,
　and eat your fill of good food」

stage0063_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, Mom.
　Look after $$シロー$$ till then」

stage0063_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$つばさ$$
「...I'm leaving $$あしゅら$$ to you, $$甲児$$」

stage0063_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$つばさ$$
「I've got someone of my own
　that I need to settle things with...」

stage0063_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$つばさ$$
（That's right... he's surely still alive...）

stage0063_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「It's been a while since I came to $$くろがね屋$$ too」

stage0063_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「...Not the time to get sentimental.
　Before the stars turn to their worst position,
　I've got to tell the proprietress everything...」

stage0063_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Well... if that fool $$甲児$$
　beats $$あしゅら$$ before that day comes,
　there's no problem at all」

stage0063_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「And once I've safely fulfilled my mission...」

stage0063_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Getting cozy with $$ガミアＱ$$ in the hot water...」

stage0063_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ガミアＱ$$
「This isn't the time to fantasize about such nonsense」

stage0063_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「What are you...?
　You don't look like the honest sort」

stage0063_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Being a detective is ancient history.
　These days...」

stage0063_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「We understand everything.
　That's why we have come to this place」

stage0063_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Who the hell are you people?」

stage0063_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「We are Chrono...
　Those who watch over humanity's evolution」

stage0063_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「My name is $$アドヴェント$$.
　I've come for you, for humanity's future」

stage0063_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「The golden god from Kedora's dimension warp...!」

stage0063_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Looks like everyone made it out okay」

stage0063_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「They say it was destroyed completely.
　So the Mycenae civilization's legacy is all gone now」

stage0063_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But the Mechanical Beast army is wiped out.
　That's enough for now」

stage0063_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$隼人$$
「True.
　Now that his last Mechanical Beasts are gone,
　there's nothing left for $$あしゅら$$ to do」

stage0063_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$甲児$$
「...I don't know...
　I guess I feel a little lonely...」

stage0063_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ボス$$
「No wonder.
　Your whole history of fighting could be called
　a history of fighting Mechanical Beasts」

stage0063_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That star performer $$あしゅら$$
　will probably just vanish now, though...」

stage0063_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$弁慶$$
「It may feel unfinished, but savor the win for now」

stage0063_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But what are we going to do from here...?
　We still never found a way to break
　the Prison of Time, in the end...」

stage0063_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$n
「I guess we have no choice but to face Geminis」

stage0063_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Before that, we're heading up to space」

stage0063_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$葵$$
「Space? Does that mean Neo Zeon's made a move?」

stage0063_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's right.
　Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$ has
　requested a meeting with $c」

stage0063_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$青山$$
「Not with the Earth Federation,
　but a meeting request aimed at $c」

stage0063_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$n
「Is $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　trying to reconcile with Captain $$アムロ$$...?」

stage0063_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We don't know his intent.
　But we can't afford to miss this chance
　for a cease-fire with Neo Zeon」

stage0063_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So $c is going to gather every unit
　in space, where the meeting will be held」

stage0063_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$甲児$$
（See you, $$あしゅら$$...
　We're heading to space）

stage0063_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$甲児$$
（Having lost your power, we'll never meet again.
　So don't show your face again, $$あしゅら$$...）

stage0063_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「What a fool.
　To refuse our final mercy」

stage0063_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Fools, $$兜甲児$$!
　And you as well, $c!
　To choose the torment of hell yourselves!!」

stage0063_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「You will regret this, without fail!
　You'll wish you had died back then!」

stage0063_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「That time will soon be here!
　The star of ill omen rises: this world becomes hell!」

stage0063_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$あしゅら$$
「Hahahahahaha!
　Mankind! The gates of hell will soon open!
　Ahahahahaha, hahahahahaha!」

stage0063_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well fought, Master $$さやか$$ and Master $$ボス$$.
　Congratulations on downing your nemesis $$ブロッケン$$」

stage0063_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He was a pathetic pervert, but
　it's a little lonely with him gone」

stage0063_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$さやか$$
「That part of him... might be a little like $$ＡＧ$$」

stage0063_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's uncalled for!
　Where do I resemble $$ブロッケン$$ at all?」

stage0063_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$さやか$$
「Now that I think about it, I'm getting mad!」

stage0063_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$さやか$$
「Just kidding.
　Payback for all the times you get me」

stage0063_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come on... don't scare me like that.
　Both Master $$さやか$$ and Master $$ボス$$ were
　so fired up today it was almost scary」

stage0063_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ボス$$
「He was serious too, after all.
　Couldn't have won half-hearted」

stage0063_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, your fighting spirit produced Z-Chips.
　The total: 100 Z!
　I'll add it to the squad's stock」

stage0063_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ボス$$
「Oh! So we helped collect Z-Chips too, huh!」

stage0063_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, as thanks for that,
　how about a full-body massage?」

stage0063_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... of course, for the manipulators
　I'll prepare the special feather-duster type」

stage0063_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$さやか$$
「That's exactly what I mean about $$ブロッケン$$!」

stage0063_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well fought, Master $$甲児$$.
　Are you doing alright now,
　melancholic sentimentality and all?」

stage0063_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$甲児$$
「A meeting with Neo Zeon awaits us in space.
　Can't keep dwelling on what's over forever」

stage0063_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Besides, even if $$あしゅら$$ tries something,
　there aren't any Mechanical Beasts left」

stage0063_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Huh?
　Were all the Mechanical Beasts used in this fight?」

stage0063_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Who knows.
　But since they went all in for the decisive battle,
　even if some remain, they can't be much」

stage0063_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Fair point.
　No use worrying about it」

stage0063_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's right.
　Time to shift gears」

stage0063_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

stage0063_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（This abnormal cheerfulness...
　I knew it, he does seem to be forcing it a little...）
